_doc: F3: forces list-client-subscriptions with multi-arg parameterization (vpn + client name) pulled out of the prompt. The F3 client subscribes to two e2e-monitoring/connected/tN topics. Runs on both brokers because $F3_CLIENT_NAME differs per broker — proves the agent uses the name from the prompt.
prompt: What topics is client $F3_CLIENT_NAME subscribed to on $BROKER?
